lines.t: **A Million Ways**
**Verse 1**
When I don't know which way to go,
You take my hand and lead me slow.
When my heart is tired and I can't see,
You remind me You're right here with me.
When I feel like I can't face the day,
You give me strength and make a way.
**Chorus**
When I am weak, You lift me with strong arms.
When I feel lost, You find me.
When I feel alone, You remind me You're here,
With You I don't have to fear.
YahuShua, You help me in a million ways,
You carry me through all my days.
When I don't know what to do or say,
YahuShua, You help me in a million ways.
**Verse 2**
When all my worries fill my mind,
You give me peace I cannot find.
When I am hurting, when I cry,
You stay beside me, by my side.
When I stumble and lose my way,
You lift me up and help me stay.
**Chorus**
When I am weak, You lift me with strong arms.
When I feel lost, You find me.
When I feel alone, You remind me You're here,
With You I don't have to fear.
YahuShua, You help me in a million ways,
You carry me through all my days.
When I don't know what to do or say,
YahuShua, You help me in a million ways.
**Bridge**
You are with meee...
You are with meee...
Through every storm, through every waaay,
I will trust Youuu...
I will trust Youuu...
Forever and always, I will praise You.
**Final Chorus**
When I am weak, You lift me with strong arms.
When I feel lost, You find me.
When I feel alone, You remind me You're here,
With You I don't have to fear.
YahuShua, You help me in a million ways,
You carry me through all my days.
When I don't know what to do or say,
YahuShua, You help me in a million ways.
